# Smart frequent watchdog deactivation notification (2026-06-08 11:24Z)

_**User**_

Reported that simulator testing showed the Smart frequent "on" notification but not the matching "off" notification.

The user then asked to commit the fix and reminded the agent to include the changelog.

---

_**Agent**_

Inspected the simulator logs and found Smart frequent returning to standard background tracking through the `smart frequent recovery watchdog exhausted` path.

Updated `LocationManager` so watchdog exhaustion no longer suppresses the Smart deactivation mode-change notification when the runtime had already been confirmed active and had sent the matching activation notification.

Updated the Smart frequent state-machine documentation and implementation notes to describe the watchdog fallback notification behavior, and added a `version 3.2` changelog bullet.

Verified with:

```sh
xcodebuild -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' build
xcodebuild -project miataru/miataru.xcodeproj -scheme miataru -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -only-testing:miataruTests/SmartFrequentBackgroundPolicyTests test
```
